scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the active Rainwake trailer transfer after the tow vehicle is stopped at the Fremont work-zone holding point.
Emerging Need: A live closure stops the run; the marshal later opens one supervised direct crossing for trailers within measured clearance limits.
Decision Context: The saved loaded-trailer measurements must be checked against the live limits; the marshal supplies and escorts the route, so Elian does not invent a side-street detour.
Consequence: If a compatible trailer misses the supervised release before 17:50, the later dock gate closure prevents unloading for this practice.

parameter.title: Tow Rainwake utility trailer to Westlake practice
parameter.description: Pick up the narrow utility trailer from Fremont storage and bring drums and spare dock bins to Westlake before evening practice staging.

parameter.subject: Fremont approach cone plan for evening bridge work
parameter.body: Evening work may stop vehicles at the Fremont holding point from 17:25. Towing drivers must remain parked for the live marshal notice; no independently chosen side-street detour is authorized. Any reopened crossing will be controlled by the work-zone crew.

parameter.content: Status update: tow run started from Fremont, but I’m stopped at the east-approach cone with the narrow utility trailer and the engine off. Marshal says trailers cannot move until SDOT opens alternates, so I’m not taking random side streets from the map.

parameter.subject: Trailer alternate window now open at Fremont cone
parameter.body: A supervised direct Fremont crossing is available for trailers held at the cone from 17:40 to 17:50. This opening accepts loaded trailer width at most 1.55 m, loaded height at most 2.00 m, trailer length at most 4.20 m and loaded trailer mass at most 900 kg. Drivers must give recorded dimensions while parked; the marshal verifies the setup, guides the crossing and hands drivers into the signed Westlake dock approach. Do not depart without that verification. The dock crew has confirmed the escorted transfer and approach take no more than 25 minutes under this controlled release, with no independent detour.

parameter.content: The gate crew confirmed unloading stays open until 18:20 tonight, including five minutes to position the trailer. A verified release by 17:50 leaves 25 minutes for the escorted transfer plus five for positioning. I am at the dock and can receive the trailer; Elian should review any message only while parked with the engine off.

parameter.subject: Westlake trailer unload gate closed
parameter.body: The Westlake trailer unload gate closed at 18:20. The escorted work-zone release has ended and late trailers cannot enter tonight’s dock lane because boat movements have begun.
